findings.title: record-run has no data-edit verb
findings.detail: data-edit exposes only upsert-task/mark-shipped/set-lifecycle/add-kanban-card/set-prompts. runs[] append is unsupported. US-004 bounds this to a re-parse+atomic-write helper, not a raw clobber, and forbids adding ralph-overview verbs (submodule/out of scope).

findings.title: MCP surface redundancy
findings.detail: ralph-overview already ships 5 id-scoped write tools; second MCP surface ~80% redundant. Operator chose skill-commands; MCP deferred. Recorded in plan + README story.

findings.title: data-edit dep-missing failure mode
findings.detail: Wrapper errors on missing @babel/parser when installed plugin deps absent. Skills must document copilot plugin update / npm install recovery; prefer in-tree dispatcher.

findings.title: status vs lifecycle conflation risk
findings.detail: take-task flips status; update-status flips lifecycle. Plan documents the axis split to prevent misuse.
